data.name: Jorawar
data.gender_notes: Jorawar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jorawar is a powerful Islamic name that signifies a warrior of great honor and integrity. The name Jorawar carries the meaning “Warrior of honor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jorawar usually hope their child will grow to embody warrior of honor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Jorawar is derived from the Arabic word 'Jurr', which means 'warrior'. It is often associated with bravery, courage, and resilience.
data.etymology: Jorawar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Warrior of honor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jorawar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: جوراور
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من جور واور بمعنى قوة و عز و جود
in_arabic.long_meaning: جوراور هو اسم مشتق من الجور و الاور و يعني القوة و العز و الجود و الكرم. و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة و الصلابة و النبلاء.

in_urdu.name: جوراور
in_urdu.meaning: جوراور کا مطلب ہے طاقت، عزت، اور سخاوت
in_urdu.long_meaning: جوراور ایک ایسا نام ہے جو عربی زبان کی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے طاقت، عزت، اور سخاوت۔ یہ نام ان خوبصورت معانی کو اپنے ساتھ جوڑتا ہے جو اسلام میں عظیم قدر رکھتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: जोरावर
in_hindi.meaning: जोरावर का अर्थ है शक्ति, सम्मान और उदारता
in_hindi.long_meaning: जोरावर एक ऐसा नाम है जो शक्ति, सम्मान और उदारता को दर्शाता है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है और अक्सर उन बच्चों को दिया जाता है जो मजबूत और साहसी होते हैं।

in_pashto.name: جوراور

data.cultural_impact: The name Jorawar carries a rich cultural impact, as it is evocative of brave warriors from Islamic history and literature. In many Islamic societies, the warrior is a revered figure, representing steadfastness in the face of adversity, and unwavering commitment to protecting the faith and community. The name serves as a reminder of these noble qualities and encourages those who bear it to embody them in their daily lives.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Jorawar holds deep significance as it symbolizes the inner warrior that each person must develop to overcome their own spiritual battles. The name inspires one to be steadfast in their faith, seek knowledge and wisdom, and to defend their beliefs with courage and integrity. Furthermore, it serves as a reminder of the emphasis on self-improvement and personal growth in Islam, as every person strives to be a better version of themselves in the eyes of God.
